verdict.rationale: Supabase exposes a full Postgres database and Management API to AI agents via its MCP server, so an agent can issue bulk SQL (batch UPDATE/DELETE/INSERT) or use the REST/Management APIs to affect many rows or manage many projects programmatically, but there is no explicit documented 'bulk operations' API/tooling designed for AI-native batch actions across items. missing for 10: dedicated bulk-operation endpoints or batch-request APIs, explicit AI-agent examples of bulk edits, independent evidence of large-scale bulk usage via MCP.
